title: SimplicialHomology: implementation of abstract simplicial complex in Mathematica
summary: Computations in simplicial homology are crucial for algebraic topology and computational geometry in general. Although several mature software systems provide facilities for working with simplicial complexes, there is currently limited support for such computations within the Wolfram language ecosystem. This paper presents SimplicialHomology, an open-source Wolfram language paclet for constructing abstract simplicial complexes and computing their homology groups over the integers, rational numbers, and finite fields.
